headline.title: The 9 biggest new features in Android 17
headline.summary: Android 17 introduces several new features, including enhanced AI capabilities such as improved dictation and vibe-coded widgets, alongside non-AI updates like an emoji overhaul and a new screentime tool. Google has outlined these significant changes aimed at improving user experience on the platform.

articles.title: Musk mulled handing OpenAI to his children, Altman testifies
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman testified that Elon Musk once considered passing control of OpenAI to his children during a "particularly hair-raising" conversation. This revelation highlights the complex relationship between Musk and the AI organization he co-founded.

articles.title: Sam Altman says Elon Musk’s mind games were damaging OpenAI
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman testified that Elon Musk's management style caused significant harm to the company's culture, citing a practice where Musk pressured leadership to rank researchers by their achievements. This statement was made during Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI, highlighting the internal challenges faced by the organization.

articles.title: Gemini’s latest updates are all about controlling your phone
articles.summary: Google has unveiled new features for its Gemini AI during a pre-I/O Android showcase, focusing on enhancing phone control and user experience. The updates will integrate Gemini across various platforms, including Chrome on Android and autofill suggestions, to assist users more effectively.

articles.title: Report: Google and SpaceX in talks to put data centers into orbit
articles.summary: Google and SpaceX are negotiating plans to establish data centers in orbit, aiming to leverage space for AI computing capabilities. Despite the potential benefits, current costs for such projects are significantly higher than traditional ground-based data centers.

articles.title: Everything Google announced at its Android Show, from Googlebooks to vibe-coded widgets
articles.summary: Google announced several new features and products at its Android Show, including AI-first Googlebooks laptops, enhanced Gemini capabilities, and vibe-coded Android widgets. The updates also include Gemini integration in Chrome and a refreshed version of Android Auto.

articles.title: Google brings agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets to Android
articles.summary: Google has introduced agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets for Android devices, enhancing user interaction and personalization. The new Gemini Intelligence features Gboard-based dictation and form-filling capabilities to streamline tasks.

articles.title: Google’s ‘Create My Widget’ feature will let you vibe code your own widgets
articles.summary: Google is set to launch its 'Create My Widget' feature this summer, allowing users to customize their own widgets through a coding interface. The feature will initially be available on the latest Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel smartphones.

articles.title: The AI legal services industry is heating up — Anthropic is getting in on the action
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched new AI tools aimed at automating clerical functions for law firms, including document search, case law resources, and deposition preparation. This move marks Anthropic's entry into the growing AI legal services industry.

articles.title: Google adds Gemini-powered dictation to Gboard, which could be bad news for dictation startups
articles.summary: Google has introduced a new dictation feature powered by its Gemini AI model to the Gboard keyboard, initially available on Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel devices. This development may pose challenges for existing dictation startups in the competitive landscape.

articles.title: George Clooney, Tom Hanks, and Meryl Streep back new ‘Human Consent Standard’ for AI licensing
articles.summary: George Clooney, Tom Hanks, and Meryl Streep are supporting a new AI licensing initiative called the Human Consent Standard, which aims to establish guidelines for the use of individuals' likenesses and creative works by AI systems. This standard allows creators to set specific terms regarding the use of their work, including the option to grant full permission for AI use.

articles.title: Rivian’s AI-powered voice assistant is ready to roll
articles.summary: Rivian has launched its AI-powered voice assistant, which is now available to owners of compatible Gen 1 and Gen 2 vehicles via a software update. The feature is accessible to users subscribed to the company's Connect Plus cellular service, priced at $15 per month or $150 annually.
